products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Genuine birch bark gives this tree natural rustic appeal
- Freestanding design suits tabletops, shelves and mantels
- Pine needles cones and berries add festive detail below
- Lightweight yet sturdy construction makes the decoration easy to move when updating your festive display.
- A charming Christmas gift choice, combining natural materials with rustic woodland character.
- Suitable for indoor festive displays.
- Freestanding tabletop decoration designed for indoor placement on tables, shelves or mantels.
- Natural rustic finish with pine needles, cones and berries arranged at the base.
- Made from genuine birch bark for an authentic natural appearance.
- Fire-retardant design for added peace of mind during seasonal indoor decorating.

## Information
Bring a natural, woodland feel to your seasonal styling with this 30cm Christmas Tree Shape Birch Bark Wooden Table Top Decoration. Designed in a tree shape and finished with genuine birch bark, it offers a rustic look that suits festive decorating in living rooms, hallways, dining spaces and other indoor areas. The decorative base features pine needles, cones and berries, adding extra seasonal detail and helping the piece feel warm, traditional and easy to style. This freestanding decoration is made to sit neatly on tabletops, shelves and mantels, so you can place it wherever you want a simple Christmas accent. Its sturdy yet lightweight construction makes it easy to move as you refresh your display through the season. The natural materials give the ornament an authentic finish, while the intricate bark pattern creates visual interest without needing additional decoration. A practical choice for homes that favour rustic Christmas decor, this table top piece works well alongside both classic and contemporary festive themes. The off-white tones of the birch bark blend easily with greenery, candles, lights and other seasonal accessories, helping you create a coordinated display with minimal effort. Because it is freestanding, it can be used on its own as a focal point or combined with other decorations for a fuller arrangement. The size is clearly suited to smaller display areas where a statement decoration is wanted without taking up too much space. At 30cm high, it offers noticeable height while remaining compact enough for everyday home styling during the holidays. The combination of natural texture and simple form makes it an appealing decorative feature for Christmas entertaining or quiet seasonal displays. This birch bark table top decoration also makes a thoughtful gift idea for family or friends who enjoy nature-inspired festive styling. Its charming tree-shaped design symbolises the season in an understated way, making it suitable for gifting as well as personal use. Whether placed on a shelf beside existing decor or used as part of a centrepiece, it adds a calm, cosy feel to your Christmas setting. Easy to position and simple to enjoy year after year, this wooden decoration offers a tasteful way to bring seasonal character into the home. It combines rustic style with festive detail in one freestanding design that feels both traditional and distinctive.

## Features
- 42cm grey wooden house adds a cozy festive focal point
- Warm white LEDs give steady light with no flashing effect

- Wooden construction offers a durable eco-friendly feel

## Information
Bring a cosy seasonal feel to your home with this red wooden Christmas tree tabletop decoration. Designed as a festive standing decoration, it works well as a centrepiece for living rooms, hallways, mantelpieces or shelf displays during the Christmas season. The decorative tree features pine and berry-style details that help create a traditional festive look while adding colour and character to your interior décor. Made from wooden material, this Christmas decoration is intended to offer a durable and eco-friendly finish for seasonal display. Its tabletop format makes it easy to position in different indoor spaces without taking up too much room, while the red colour provides a bold festive accent that suits classic holiday styling. The design is aimed at helping you create a rich Christmas atmosphere with an eye-catching decorative piece that complements other seasonal ornaments. This light-up decoration is battery operated for flexible placement and requires 3 x AA batteries, which are not included. It includes 15 small warm white LED bulbs that give off a steady light with no flashing effect, helping to produce a calm and welcoming glow throughout the home. The warm white lighting adds depth to the design without overpowering the rest of your display, making it suitable for creating a soft festive ambience. With dimensions of 42 x 35 x 5 cm, this tabletop Christmas tree is sized for decorative indoor use where you want a compact but noticeable seasonal feature. The combination of wooden construction, red finish, pine accents and warm white LEDs gives it a traditional look that can be enjoyed year after year as part of your Christmas decorating scheme. It is supplied as 1 piece and offers an easy way to add festive style to your home décor. Whether placed on a table, sideboard or shelf, this LED wooden tree helps set a welcoming mood for family gatherings and seasonal celebrations. Its simple battery-powered design means you can position it where it looks best without needing a mains connection, while the steady warm white lights help bring an elegant finishing touch to your Christmas display.

## Features

- Eight light modes let you vary the display easily

## Information
From the manufacturer, this fibre optic Christmas tree brings a bright, colourful finish to seasonal decorating. The built-in multi-coloured lighting helps create a warm festive glow across the branches, while the illuminated star topper adds a classic finishing touch. Designed for simple indoor display, it offers a convenient way to bring holiday charm to living rooms, offices and other spaces where a cheerful centrepiece is wanted. The tree is pre-lit with integrated fibre optic LED lights, so there is no need to add separate string lights before setting it up. The lighting is built into the design to provide an eye-catching display with minimal effort. An eight-mode lighting effect gives you different ways to enjoy the tree’s appearance through the season, helping you vary the look without changing decorations or adding extra accessories. A sturdy stand supports the tree and helps keep it steady once positioned in place. This practical base is designed to provide reliable support for indoor use, making the tree suitable for creating a focal point in your home or workplace during Christmas. Its ready-to-display format makes it straightforward to place, enjoy and pack away again after the season has finished. The product’s fibre optic construction gives it a distinctive illuminated style that stands out in festive settings. Multi-coloured light effects brighten the tree from within and work with the star topper to create a lively seasonal feature. Because the lighting is already integrated, it offers an easy decorative option for customers who want a traditional Christmas look with built-in illumination rather than separate lights or additional ornament sets. Suitable for indoor seasonal décor, this 5ft artificial Christmas tree combines convenience with decorative appeal. It provides a colourful display that can suit homes, offices and other indoor spaces where a festive centrepiece is needed. With its integrated lighting, star topper and stable base, it is designed to offer an attractive and practical way to enjoy Christmas decorations throughout the season.

## Features
- tabletop twig tree fits neatly into smaller spaces, including tables, shelves and display areas
- Twenty-four steady warm white LEDs create a gentle glow for festive displays and relaxed room décor
- Posable branches allow you to adjust the shape and create a natural-looking display
- USB or 3×AA battery power offers flexible placement without requiring a nearby mains socket
- The minimalist white finish complements contemporary interiors and suits both seasonal and year-round display
- The pop-up design and foldable stand make setup straightforward and storage more convenient.
- PVC construction provides a reusable option for seasonal indoor decoration.
- For indoor use only, and not suitable for children under 36 months.
- Covered by the applicable statutory warranty period.
- Fire-retardant design supports safer use as an indoor decorative light.

## Information
Add a soft seasonal glow to your home with this 60cm white twig tree from Shatchi. It features 24 steady warm white LEDs for gentle ambient lighting, making it suitable for Christmas displays and everyday décor. The posable branches can be shaped to create your preferred look on tables, consoles, shelves, windowsills or bedside spaces. Its clean white finish brings a contemporary touch to modern interiors. Choose USB power or use 3×AA batteries, not included, for flexible indoor placement without relying on a nearby mains socket. The PVC construction is designed for repeat seasonal use, while the pop-up format and foldable stand support easy setup and storage. Not suitable for children under 36 months.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Green wooden design brings classic festive style
- 12 warm white LEDs add a soft steady glow
- Battery operation allows flexible indoor placement
- Pine and berry detail enhances seasonal appeal
- 42cm size suits tabletops shelves or mantels
- Battery-operated design requires 3 x AA batteries, which are not included.
- 12 warm white LED bulbs provide a steady light effect without flashing.
- Pine and berry decorations add a traditional Christmas-inspired finish.
- Compact 23 x 10 x 43H cm tabletop size suits living rooms, hallways and mantel displays.
- Fire-retardant design for added peace of mind during indoor seasonal display.

## Information
Add a festive focal point to your home with this green wooden Christmas tabletop decoration. Designed to create a rich seasonal atmosphere, it works well as a decorative centrepiece for living rooms, hallways, dining areas or other indoor display spaces. The traditional look is enhanced with pine and berry detail, giving the piece a classic Christmas feel that suits both modern and more traditional interiors. This standing decoration is battery operated for flexible placement, so it can be positioned where you want seasonal light without needing a mains connection. It uses 12 small warm white LED bulbs with a steady light effect and no flashing, helping to create a gentle glow for evening displays. The lights are described as warm white, making them suitable for adding subtle decoration rather than harsh brightness. Made from high-quality wooden material, the decoration is described as safe, durable and eco-friendly. Its green finish helps it blend naturally into festive arrangements while still standing out as a seasonal feature. At 42cm in size, it offers a noticeable presence without taking up too much space, making it practical for tabletops, shelves, mantelpieces or sideboards. The product requires 3 x AA batteries, which are not included. That makes it easy to place in different parts of the home without cables getting in the way. products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Compact 4ft size makes this artificial Christmas tree suitable for smaller rooms, tabletops, corners and other indoor spaces where a larger tree may not fit comfortably during the festive season.
- Black finish gives a modern decorative look and creates a strong backdrop for baubles, ribbons and lights, helping you build a personalised Christmas display that suits your chosen style.
- Made from PVC material for seasonal decorative use, offering an artificial alternative that can be packed away after Christmas and brought out again for future indoor displays.
- Ideal for home or office decorating when you want something different from a traditional green tree, with plenty of scope to style it simply or make it the focus of your festive theme.
- A practical base for indoor Christmas décor that can be dressed with your own ornaments and lights; always follow safe installation guidance when adding electrical decorations.

## Information
Create a striking seasonal display with this 4ft black artificial Christmas tree, designed for indoor decorative use in the home, office or retail-style settings. The black finish offers a modern alternative to a traditional green tree and provides a bold backdrop for baubles, ribbons, lights and other festive decorations. With a compact 4ft size, it is well suited to smaller rooms, tabletops, corners or spaces where a full-size tree may not be practical. Made from PVC, this artificial tree is intended for repeated seasonal use and offers a convenient option for customers who want an easy-to-set-up decorative tree without the need for watering or needle clean-up. Its artificial construction makes it suitable for creating a consistent look year after year, while the neutral structure allows you to personalise the final display to suit your chosen theme. This product is ideal for customers looking to add something different to their Christmas décor. The black colour can work especially well with metallic accents, bright ornaments or monochrome styling, helping create a contemporary festive feature. Because the tree is artificial, it can be packed away after use and brought out again for future celebrations. Use this tree as part of your Christmas decorating scheme in living rooms, hallways, reception areas or display spaces. It can be styled simply for a minimal look or dressed more fully for a fuller festive centrepiece. As with all decorative items, care should be taken when adding lights and ornaments so that they are used safely and appropriately indoors. The compact format makes it suitable where floor space is limited but you still want an eye-catching seasonal feature. Whether used on its own or as part of a wider Christmas display, this black artificial tree provides a versatile base for festive styling and decoration.

## Features
- Spiral Christmas tree captures the lush beauty of evergreens in stunning detail
- Has 448 lifelike branch tips, 39 natural pine cones, and 39 clusters of red berries
- High-quality material to maintain a vibrant appearance through every festive season
- 140 warm white LED lights with 8 lighting modes
- Perfect for your home, office, shop and more

## Information
This 5 ft spiral Christmas tree boasts 448 dense branch tips adorned with 39 natural pine cones and 39 clusters of vibrant red berries. Illuminated by 140 warm white LED lights, it features 8 dynamic lighting modes: combination, in wave, sequential, slo glo, chasing/flash, slow fade, twinkle/flash, and steady on. The memory function remembers your previous setting, making it great for adding a decorative touch to any event. Crafted from new PVC, this festive decoration tree is fireproof, anti-fading, non-allergic, and smell-free. It stands firmly on a robust folding metal base equipped with protective foot pads to guard your floors. Included gloves make assembly effortless and safe. Designed with a slim pencil shape, this Xmas tree fits effortlessly into tight spaces like cozy apartments, modern offices, or bustling retail spots - perfect for infusing festive cheer without sacrificing room. Note: Ornaments are not included. Merry Christmas!

## Features
- Mini spruce tree with 96 dense branch tips and thick PE leaves
- Vibrant evergreen foliage for lush natural seasonal aesthetic
- Generates cozy festive ambiance with 20 warm white LED lights

## Information
Bring charming holiday decorations to your tabletop.Loaded with 96 full branch tips, this 18\"/46 cm mini spruce tree achieves a full look once you arrange its branches, and it elevates every corner of your home effortlessly. Warm white glow for gentle ambience comes from its 20 LED lights, controlled by an IP44 battery box with a 6-hour-on and 18-hour-off timer to cast soft festive light. Its base weaves natural willow for warm holiday texture and packs cement inside to steady your festive evergreen, keeping the tree stable without extra stands. The compact size fits nicely on desks and counters, ideal for home and small business seasonal decoration. Note: Ornaments are not included.

- Vibrant evergreen foliage brings woodland charm

- Timer function (6 hours on, 18 hours off) for convenient on/off lighting cycles

## Information
Fill your space with delicate, cozy festive vibes for a heartfelt holiday celebration.Loaded with 71 branch tips and vivid PVC leaves, this mini tree perfectly simulates the organic look of a real fir tree. Equipped with 35 LED lights, it emits soft warm white glow for gentle ambience. Supported by an IP44 battery box with a built-in 6-hour-on and 18-hour-off timer function, the steady warm light flows over layered branches and elevates every corner of your home effortlessly. Featured with a festive base cushioned with soft red plush, it brings inviting holiday aesthetics with an exquisite potted look. The cement-filled weighted design provides stable grounding, keeping the tree upright steadily. Measuring 61 cm in compact size, it is ideal for tabletop display, like desks, side tables and countertops. Note: Ornaments are not included.

## Features
- Enchanting Lighting Effects: The 3 ft Xmas tree is adorned with 30 warm white LED lights that cast a gentle, inviting glow. Moreover, the tree boasts an automatic timer that conveniently turns the lights on for 6 hours and off for 18 hours.

## Information
Bringing the enchanting spirit of the holiday season to your space is a 3 ft Xmas tree adorned with 30 warm white LED lights. Its design includes a vibrant treetop, lush pine needles, artificial leaves, pine cones, and white berries for a lifelike appearance. The tabletop Christmas tree stands securely on a cement-filled base wrapped in rustic linen fabric, blending stability with rustic charm. Additionally, its flocked design creates the illusion of a dusting of snow, making it a visually striking centerpiece for tabletops in homes, offices, shops, or schools. Merry Christmas!

## Information
Create a classic festive display with the Pelle & Sol Artificial Christmas Tree. Designed with realistic pine-style branches and lush green tips, this reusable tree brings the traditional look of Christmas greenery into your home or festive display. The sturdy stand provides reliable support, while the branches can be expanded and shaped during assembly to create a fuller appearance ready for your favourite lights, baubles and ornaments. Suitable for indoor and outdoor decorative displays, the tree is quick to assemble and easy to store between festive seasons. Available in 4ft, 5ft and 6ft sizes, you can choose the ideal height for bedrooms, hallways, living rooms and larger Christmas spaces. Its classic green finish provides a versatile base for traditional, modern or personalised festive decorating year after year.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- The modern white twig design adds a clean, festive accent to tables, shelves, consoles and windowsills.
- Warm white LED lighting creates soft ambient illumination without overpowering your decorative arrangement.
- USB or battery operation allows the tree to be displayed indoors without relying on a fixed power connection.
- Arrange the posable branches to create the shape and fullness that best suits your space.
- Lightweight construction makes the tree easy to position, pack away and reuse for Christmas or other decorative occasions.
- Made from PVC with a clean white twig-style branch finish for a modern decorative look.
- Twenty-four steady warm white LEDs provide a gentle glow for an inviting seasonal display.
- Choose USB power or 3 x AA batteries for flexible placement; batteries are not included.
- Posable branches can be arranged to create a fuller, more personalised decorative shape.
- Fire-retardant design provides an added consideration for seasonal indoor decorating.

## Information
Add a soft seasonal glow to your home with this 60cm white twig tree from Shatchi. It features 24 steady warm white LEDs for gentle ambient lighting, making it suitable for Christmas displays and everyday décor. The posable branches can be shaped to create your preferred look on tables, consoles, shelves, windowsills or bedside spaces. Its clean white finish brings a contemporary touch to modern interiors. Choose USB power or use 3×AA batteries, not included, for flexible indoor placement without relying on a nearby mains socket. The PVC construction is designed for repeat seasonal use, while the pop-up format and foldable stand support easy setup and storage. Not suitable for children under 36 months.

## Features
- Mini fir tree with 75 dense branch tips
- Features snow frosted design for a winter scene
- 6 natural pine cones add rustic seasonal charm
- Generates cozy festive ambiance with 50 warm white LED lights

## Information
Create cozy frosted holiday vibes and refresh your indoor decorations effortlessly.Featuring 75 branch tips and vivid PVC foliage, this mini fir tree boasts dense layered boughs with delicate frosted detailing and 6 natural pine cones, restoring the lifelike vitality of a real evergreen tree. Fitted with 50 LED lights, the tree offers soft warm white glow for gentle ambience. Powered by an IP44 battery box with a 6-hour-on, 18-hour-off timer cycle, the warm glow elevates every corner of your home effortlessly. Its exquisite potted base is wrapped in textured burlap for warm rustic charm, while the weighted cement filling keeps the tree firmly upright. Compact at 61 cm, this space-saving tree is perfect for tabletop display, fitting well on desks, side tables and countertops. Note: Ornaments are not included.

## Features
- 90 cm tabletop size for flexible seasonal placement
- 86 branch tips form abundant greenery profile
- Santa inspired design captures a playful character
- 20 warm white LED lights provide gentle brightness

## Information
Bring playful Christmas cheer to your holiday decorating!This mini tabletop Christmas tree combines seasonal greenery, cheerful Santa details, and inviting illumination in a compact format that brings personality to your festive arrangement. Standing 3 ft/90 cm tall, the artificial Xmas tree features 86 verdant branch tips for plentiful greenery, complemented by a plaid hat, soft white beard, and matching Santa-style boots. 20 warm white LED lights brighten the foliage, while 8 lighting modes (combination, in waves, sequential, slo glo, chasing/flash, fade, twinkle/flash, steady on) provide multiple effects for changing the ambiance throughout the season. With battery operation, the lighting is not restricted by a nearby outlet, and the integrated timer automatically follows a 6-hour on/18-hour off cycle. Premium PVC foliage offers flame-retardant, fade-resistant, smell-free, and non-allergic properties for added reassurance around children and pets. At the bottom, cement-filled black boots provide weighted support to maintain a steady position while carrying the Santa theme through to the base. Compact and easy to reposition, this small realistic Christmas tree fits neatly on entry tables, mantels, office desks, and other limited surfaces. Note: Battery box requires 3 AA batteries, not included.Note: The decorations are not included.

## Features
- Designed with wintry flocking
- Features a folding metal stand for stability
- LED lights can serve for a longer time
- Insert-in design makes it convenient to install
- Capture your attention at home and office
- Safe & Charming LED Lights: 120 LED lights can not only keep the 4.5 ft Xmas tree glowing warm white but also present higher security. Except for the UKCA certification included, they are also low-voltage and energy-saving.
- Lush & Snowy Branch Tips: Since the Christmas tree contains up to 757 branch tips, it perfectly resembles a luxuriant real tree. Plus, leaves are uniformly flocked, which can bring you the wintry charm.
- New PE & PVC Materials: The Xmas tree cleverly mixes PE & PVC leaves, which are 100% new for ideal resistance to fire, fading & allergies. Plus, PE leaves feel thicker & more realistic, making the Xmas decoration tree more lifelike.
- Simple Setup & Storage: Its hinged frame makes setup a breeze. 2 sections need to be attached in order & its branch tips will expand automatically. When Christmas is over, you can easily disassemble the tree for compact storage.
- Capture your attention at home and office

## Information
Illuminate your holiday with this enchanting 6 ft Christmas tree. A spectacle of 260 LED lights casts a warm white glow, creating a safe & captivating ambiance. Its lights operate at low voltage while conserving energy for maximum security. Delight in the sight of 1415 branch tips, meticulously flocked to mimic the allure of a real wintry tree. Crafted from a brilliant fusion of PE & PVC materials, this regal masterpiece endures fire, fading & allergies, radiating authenticity throughout the season. Effortlessly assembled with its hinged frame, the Xmas tree expands its branches automatically. Also, it is convenient to disassemble the Xmas wonder into 3 sections for storage. Sturdy & poised on a folding metal stand, it proudly graces any setting without wobbling. Its anti-slip foot pads ensure floor protection, making it a versatile choice for home, school, or office decoration.

## Features
- 129 branch tips form abundant greenery profile
- 3 types of leaves add layered visual interest
- 10 red berry clusters introduce bright seasonal accents
- Flame-retardant and smell-free material adds dependable seasonal safety

## Information
Bring natural texture and a warm holiday glow to your space!This potted Christmas tree combines layered greenery, seasonal berry accents, and inviting illumination in a compact form that adds character without requiring much room. Featuring 129 branch tips and 10 clusters of red berries, the foliage blends verdant PVC leaves, frosted pine needles, and snowy PE leaves to create different textures and shades for a richly dimensional effect. 80 warm white LED lights illuminate this pre-lit Christmas tree, with 8 lighting modes (combination, in waves, sequential, slo glo, chasing/flash, fade, twinkle/flash, steady on) offering varied effects to suit different festive moods. Battery-powered operation provides more freedom when positioning the tree, while the built-in timer follows a convenient 6-hour on/18-hour off cycle. Made with premium PVC and PE foliage, this artificial Xmas tree offers flame-retardant, fade-resistant, smell-free, and non-allergic properties for added reassurance. A cement-filled flowerpot provides firm support, while windowpane-inspired accents allow the internal light to shine through, adding another layer of decorative illumination. Its compact profile complements front porches, entryways, living rooms, coffee shops, and other seasonal settings with ease.Note: The decorations are not included.

## Information
Bring a festive centrepiece to your home or office with this artificial Christmas tree. It stands 5ft (150cm) tall with an approximate width of 75cm and is finished in green, with 400 PVC tips across densely packed branches for a full, realistic look. The green finish complements bright-coloured decorations for a stylish festive display. Assembly is straightforward thanks to hinged branches and three simple connect sections, and a steel stand is included to keep the tree stable. - Realistic spruce tree with 545lush branch tips and vivid PVC leaves

## Information
Fill your home with dreamy winter snowy charm with this 6ft flocked Christmas tree.Generously powdered with soft white flocking to recreate the serene look of fresh snowfall, its delicate snow-laden branches form a breathtaking holiday focal point. Boasting 545 dense branch tips and premium PVC foliage, this artificial tree features a deeply layered natural evergreen silhouette. It assembles in just 2 minutes with 3 straightforward steps: unfold the base and install the 2 poles, place the pop up tree from the top down, then flare out the leaves to reveal its full lush shape. Its foldable X-shaped metal stand locks securely in place, and thanks to its collapsible design, the tree compacts neatly once the holidays end. Note: A little flocking may shed during first setup, gentle handling works best! Crafted from premium PVC material, this full spruce tree is flame-retardant, non-allergic and smell-free. Versatile enough for cozy family nights, lively holiday parties and eye-catching retail displays, it turns any space into a warm festive haven brimming with joyful holiday spirit. Note: Ornaments are not included.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Remote control makes changing light modes quick
- Eight lighting modes help vary your festive display
- Adjustable brightness allows softer or brighter
- Timer function adds convenience to your routine
- PVC build gives a practical artificial tree finish
- Pop-up artificial tree design includes a sturdy foldable stand for practical setup and handling.
- Multicolour fibre optic lighting creates a vibrant decorative effect for festive indoor displays.
- Pre-lit design helps create a ready-to-display Christmas centrepiece with minimal decorating effort.
- Partial assembly is required, with a design that can be assembled, dismantled and stored conveniently.
- Fire-retardant construction supports safer seasonal decorating when used in accordance with the safety guidance.

## Information
Create a festive focal point in smaller spaces with this 4ft LED fibre optic Christmas tree. Designed for indoor seasonal decorating, it offers a compact height that suits tabletops, offices, porches or rooms where space is limited. The fibre optic effect gives the tree a decorative illuminated finish, while the LED lights help produce an eye-catching display for Christmas and winter celebrations. With remote control operation, you can switch between eight light modes to suit different moods and occasions without needing to reach the tree each time. Adjustable brightness lets you tailor the look of the display, whether you want a subtle glow or a brighter feature for evening use. A timer function adds everyday convenience and helps manage your lighting routine during the festive period. The tree is made from PVC for a practical artificial finish that is easy to handle and assemble. Its lightweight construction makes it straightforward to position in the home and simple to store away after the season. This makes it a useful choice for those who want a decorative tree with flexible lighting controls but without taking up too much room. The compact design works well as part of a larger Christmas display or as a standalone feature in smaller settings. Whether placed in a living room corner, hallway, office or sheltered outdoor space, it provides an attractive seasonal accent with useful control features built in. For customers looking for an artificial Christmas tree that combines convenience with decorative appeal, this 4ft fibre optic option offers a practical balance of style and ease of use. It is suitable for creating a welcoming festive atmosphere while keeping setup simple and storage manageable once celebrations are over.

Decorated with 26 natural pine cones and 26 vibrant red berry clusters, it adds a festive touch to any space. Its 2-section design features hinged connections and allows for simple setup, complete with protective gloves for a hassle-free experience. This tree has a robust folding metal stand featuring a preinstalled bolt and protective foot pads. Truly, these Xmas trees turn any space into a winter wonderland. Please note, ornaments are not included. Merry Christmas!

## Features
- Ultra-slim base for maximizing room space
- Effortless brightness with warm white LED lights
- 8 lighting modes cater to different moods and occasions
- Timer function: 6 hours on and 18 hours off

## Information
Elevate Your Holiday Decoration!Our 214 cm pre-lit Christmas tree features a slender profile for a captivating, space-saving statement that glows with festive brilliance. It features clear incandescent-style LED lights, offering warm white lighting with 8 modes and 4 adjustable brightness settings, easily controlled by an on-the-tree controller and remote for seamless celebrations. Designed for easy assembly and compact storage, the tree consists of 3 connectable sections and a foldable base with a pre-assembled screw, plus 2 pairs of gloves for hassle-free setup and takedown. products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- 997 LED CHRISTMAS DISPLAY  Create an impressive festive centrepiece with this large light up pyramid tree, illuminated by 997 rainbow LEDs arranged around its distinctive cone-shaped frame.
- ANIMATED SPINNING LIGHT EFFECTS  The LEDs produce eye-catching spinning effects across the tree, bringing movement and added visual impact to your Christmas garden, entrance or indoor festive display.
- ADJUSTABLE SPEED CONTROLLER  A dedicated controller is supplied so you can alter the speed of the animated lighting effects and customise the appearance of the display.
- 8-HOUR AUTOMATIC TIMER  Use the convenient timer function to keep the lights illuminated for 8 hours before automatically switching them off for 16 hours, repeating the cycle daily.
- MAINS POWERED WITH 10M CABLE  Powered from the mains for consistent illumination and supplied with a generous 10m power cable.

## Information
Create a spectacular festive focal point with this striking 3m light up pyramid tree. Packed with an impressive 997 LEDs, the tall cone-shaped display light up with rainbow illumination with eye-catching spinning light effects including steady on effect for a Christmas decoration that really comes alive after dark. Designed to create maximum impact without the bulk of a traditional Christmas tree, the LEDs form a dramatic pyramid silhouette around a strong central metal pole. A sturdy black base helps support the structure, making it ideal for creating a statement feature in gardens, on patios, beside an entrance or as part of a larger festive display. Mains powered with a generous 10m power cable, the tree gives you added flexibility when positioning it around the home or garden. A supplied speed controller lets you adjust the pace of the lighting effects including static to suit the atmosphere you're creating. Slow things down for a softer festive shimmer or increase the speed for a more energetic animated display. The built-in 8-hour timer makes daily use wonderfully convenient. Once activated, the tree remains illuminated for 8 hours before automatically switching off for 16 hours, then repeats at the same time each day. Suitable for indoor and outdoor use (transformer plug must remain indoors) Product Specifications 997 White and Warm White Multi-Action LEDs Height: 3m Length: 70cm Width: 70cm Mains Powered with 10m Power Cable Timer Function 8 hours on 16 hours off

## Features
- Vivid & Romantic Appearance: The 6 ft pre-lit artificial Christmas tree features a full-white appearance and 383 snow-flocked branch tips, which can transform your home into a winter wonderland. Moreover, there exist 300 color-changeable fairy LED lights.

A pair of gloves is included for your protection. Get ready to immerse yourself in the enchantment of the Xmas tree.

## Features
- High quality green needles and snow-covered tips
- Premium PVC and injection-moulded needles
- Realistic branches and trunk
- Flexible branches
- Quick assembly with plug-in mechanism

## Information
Transform your home with the new artificial Christmas tree Blitzen from tectake. With its rich green needles and white snow-dusted tips, this tree instantly brings a festive atmosphere to any room. The artificial Christmas tree perfectly imitates a pine tree and is designed to support lights, decorations and more. The combination of injection-moulded needles and wood-look trunk ensures a voluminous and authentic look.Low maintenance and durable, assembly is effortless thanks to the practical plug-in mechanism and folding tree stand. After the festive season, the approx. 6ft tree can be easily dismantled into its individual parts and stored in a slim space-saving manner. Unlike real trees, this fir tree remains evergreen, does not shed needles and can be reused every year, making it a reusable alternative to a real tree. Enjoy more time putting up decorations and less time cleaning up – just add your own white and green lights for your perfect Christmas at home

## Features
- Lush Design & Safe Materials: The 5 ft Xmas tree features 844 verdant branch tips that are meticulously crafted from 100% new materials, PE and PVC. Therefore, the decoration tree is fireproof, non-allergic, anti-fading, and smell-free.
- Multi-Color Illumination: The pre-lit Christmas tree is equipped with 250 LED lights that enable you to switch between warm white and colorful options. Additionally, the included UL-certificated adaptor ensures the lighting show is safe.
- Multifunctional Settings: The Xmas tree offers 11 stunning lighting modes, 3 auto timers and 4-level brightness. The smart memory function conveniently saves your last setting, ensuring your preferred display is ready to dazzle at any moment.
- Easy Assembly & Control: Set up your holiday centerpiece with ease using the Xmas trees hinged connection, folding metal stand, and 2 pairs of gloves included. Besides, you can effortlessly customize your holiday ambiance with the remote control.
- Metal stand that provides strong support

## Information
Standing at 5 ft tall, this beautifully designed Xmas tree boasts 844 lush branch tips made from safe materials like PE and PVC. Equipped with 250 LED lights and a secure adaptor, it offers a choice of warm white or colorful lighting options and features 11 different lighting modes, such as B quick flash, B slow flash, A/B steady on, A/B colour changing quick flash, A/B colour changing slow flash, A/B colour changing 5 times, A/B colour changing slow fade, etc. Besides, the decoration tree comes with a remote control, 3 auto timers, including 6 hours on and 18 hours off, 8 hours on and 16 hours off, and 6 hours on, 6 hours off, 3 hours on, and 9 hours off. The multifunctional Xmas tree with memory function also provides adjustable brightness. Enjoy easy setup with hinged connections, a folding stand and included gloves. Perfect for enhancing celebrations in offices, shops, and carnivals, this versatile Xmas tree can light up your Christmas. More superior details await your discovery. Merry Christmas!

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- 130 warm white LED lights offer captivating glow
- Realistic fir tree with snowy design brings winter
- Folding metal stand ensures convenient storage
- Slim pencil shape fits any corners

## Information
Start an awesome new year with the pre-lit artificial Christmas tree. The 5 ft Christmas tree is pre-lit with 130 warm white LED lights, featuring 8 customizable lighting effects: combination, in wave, sequential, slow glow, chasing/flash, slow fade, twinkle/flash, and steady on. For a more lifelike appearance, this slim pencil tree is designed with 407snowy branch tips made from premium flame-retardant PE & PVC, creating a lush and realistic fir look. Assembly is simple thanks to 2 detachable trunk sections and a foldable metal stand with a pre-installed bolt. Gloves are included to help protect your hands during setup. Ideal for adding festive charm, these slim Christmas trees serve as a vivid and classic centrepiece for homes, apartments, storefronts, or offices. Note: Ornaments are not included! A little flocking may shed during first setup; gentle handling works best!

The artificial Christmas tree Cupid from tectake is the perfect choice for any home looking to enhance their festive spirit. With the trees rich green colour, it brings a cosy atmosphere to your living room. Thanks to the use of injection moulding and PVC needles, the artificial Christmas tree looks particularly realistic. The tree trunk with its wooden appearance enhances the realistic look and gives your Christmas tree an authentic look, making every room shine in festive splendour. A real advantage of an artificial Christmas tree is its ease of care. You don't have to worry about drying out or annoying needle loss, as is the case with real trees. It remains in perfect shape throughout the Christmas season and can be reused every year. This makes it a particularly sustainable solution for the holidays. With the innovative plug-in mechanism, the artificial pine tree can be effortlessly set up in just a few minutes. This leaves more time to add your favourite lights and best decorations so you can truly get into the Christmas spirit. The stable tree stand provides secure support and after the festive season, the Christmas tree can be dismantled into its individual parts and stored compactly. Opt for the artificial Christmas tree Cupid from tectake and enjoy a worry-free festive season in your home, without having to forgo the charm of a natural tree!

Make your festival decoration stand out with the pre-lit Christmas tree.The pre-lit Xmas tree features 190 warm white(LED 1) and multi-color(LED 2) changeable LED lights, creating a refined festive ambiance. ## Features
- 2 color modes are switchable to meet different people's needs
- Remote & light controller allow you to customize the lighting with ease
- Hinged branches automatically expand to fan shape

## Information
Bring festive brilliance to your space with the artificial Christmas tree.The 185cm Christmas tree features 1628 branch tips and 300 built-in LED lights, creating a lush and inviting look. - 1801 vivid branch tips with gradient colour to simulate real leaves

The upgraded folding metal stand not only adds stability but also safeguards floors with its rounded legs. Its preinstalled bolt can eliminate aligning & mismatches, while its 2 pairs of gloves will ensure better protection.

Transform your home into a festive wonderland with the Arundel 6.5ft Artificial Pine Christmas Tree. This feature makes it the ideal choice for anyone looking for a realistic artificial tree with pine cones that also offers practical space for decorating. Featuring a user-friendly 3-section design, this easy-to-assemble Christmas tree allows you to set up your holiday centrepiece in minutes. Built for long-term use, the tree includes a sturdy metal stand that ensures excellent stability throughout the festive season. It is just as easy to take down, too. It disassembles quickly and can be neatly packed into its original box for compact storage - ready to bring holiday cheer again next year. ## Features
- Blends thick PE leaves and lifelike PVC foliage
- Bring dreamy winter magic inside with this tree
- Soft warm white glow emanates from this pre lit tree

## Information
Create a snow-kissed festive centerpiece for your home with this full-bodied flocked Christmas tree.Loaded with 387/591 lush branch tips, blended PE and PVC foliage and 23/29 natural pine cones , it serves as a lush and eye-catching holiday focal display. Crafted from 100% new PE and PVC materials, the tree features outstanding fade resistance, flame-retardant, allergy-proof and smell-free traits, maintaining its full, snowy vibrant appearance for repeated holiday use with zero decorating worries. Note: Ornaments are not included.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Snow covered green tips create a classic winter look
- Hinged branches make assembly quick and simple indoors
- PVC tips provide a practical reusable festive finish
- Metal base helps keep the tree upright and stable
- Suitable for homes, shops, malls and other displays
- Hinged branches support straightforward assembly and make disassembly easier after the festive season.
- PVC tip material provides a practical decorative finish for repeated seasonal use.
- The included metal stand helps keep the tree upright and stable during indoor use.
- Traditional Californian Pine styling with snow-covered green tips creates a classic winter appearance.
- Fire-retardant construction is suitable for indoor festive displays.

## Information
Create a classic seasonal centrepiece with this 6ft Californian Pine artificial Christmas tree, designed for indoor festive displays in homes, shops, malls and other decorated settings. The snow covered green tips give the tree a traditional winter look, while the bushy profile helps create a fuller appearance once it is assembled and styled. Built with an advanced hinged structure, the tree is intended to make setup straightforward and disassembly easier when the season is over. This practical design helps save time during decorating and makes storage more convenient between uses. The supplied metal base adds stability and helps keep the tree standing straight during display. Made with PVC tips and a metal frame and stand, it offers a reusable decorative option for Christmas celebrations year after year. Suitable for indoor use, it can be used as part of home décor or in commercial festive displays where a reliable artificial tree is preferred. The overall look balances a natural pine style with a snowy finish, making it easy to coordinate with lights, baubles and other seasonal decorations. Package contents include one Christmas tree and one stand with screws, giving you the key components needed to get started once unboxed.

## Features
- Creates a fuller holiday look with 719 branch tips
- Glows vividly with multicolored 220 RGB LED light balls
- Offers flexible lighting with 10 adjustment levels
- Syncs festive ambiance with music rhythm modes

## Information
Transform your holiday ambiance with endless luminous possibilities with this smart RGB pre-lit pencil Christmas tree.Designed to provide immersive colorful lighting magic, this pre-lit Xmas tree is equipped with 220 RGB LED light balls, supporting up to 16 million color variations to liven up any holiday gathering. products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Vibrant balsam fir tree with 631 full branch tips
- Has pine needles, greenery PVC leaves and PE leaves with ice crystal accents
- Lifelike design with 35 natural pine cones and 35 clusters of red berries
- Offers 280 pre-lit LED lights for magical ambiance

## Information
Bring the magic of the holidays to your home with elegance and ease!This 6 ft Christmas tree boasts a lush balsam fir design with 631 branch tips, accented by PE and PVC foliage, soft cashmere pine needles, 35 natural pine cones, and 35 vibrant red berry clusters for a festive touch. Pre-strung with 280 bright LED lights, it offers 9 dynamic lighting modes (change slow, C1 flash, C2 flash, change flash, change twinkle, etc), and 2 color options, warm white and multi-color. Designed for quick setup, hinged branches automatically fall into place, while a sturdy folding metal stand ensures stability and an instantly full appearance. Included gloves make decorating easier. Crafted from premium flame-retardant, non-allergic, smell-free, and fade-resistant materials, this artificial fir maintains its fresh beauty year after year. With a generous 9 ft/275 cm power cord, you can position this seasonal centerpiece anywhere in your home to create a warm, inviting holiday ambiance. Merry Christmas! Note: Ornaments are not included.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Snow kissed spruce tree with 1284 branch tips
- Creates snowy holiday scenes with flocking
- 550 warm white LED lights for festive glow
- UL certified adapter with 150 cm long power cord

## Information
Elevate every corner of your home effortlessly with this snow-flocked Christmas tree.This tree features low-shed, firmly bonded flocking for a realistic snow-capped look. Loaded with 1284 dense branch tips and lifelike PVC leaves, its layered sprigs form a full, voluminous silhouette. Pre-lit with 550 warm white LED bulbs and powered by a UKCA certified adapter, it allows you to switch between lights on for steady welcoming glow and lights off to admire the tree's natural snow-dusted beauty. Built with a 3-section hinged structure and robust metal stand, it unfolds quickly and stores flat; included gloves protect hands during foliage fluffing. Made of 100% new PVC material, it is flame-retardant, anti-fading, allergy-proof and smell-free for safe indoor holiday decoration year after year. Note: Ornaments are not included.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- 12ft height creates an impressive festive focal point
- Black Alaskan Pine styling adds a modern seasonal look
- 100% virgin PVC tips offer practical reusable decoration
- Fire retardant tips provide added peace of mind indoors
- Wrapped branches help make assembly quicker and easier
- Pop-up design with a sturdy, foldable stand helps make setup straightforward.
- Wrapped construction keeps the branches attached directly to the tree, helping make assembly quicker and simpler.
- The included plastic stand protector helps protect flooring beneath the sturdy metal base during indoor use.
- Made from 100% virgin PVC with fire-retardant tips for a practical artificial Christmas tree option.
- Safety guidance: not suitable for children under 36 months.

## Information
Bring a bold festive look to your home with this 12ft black Artificial Alaskan Pine Christmas tree. Designed with classic pine tips, it creates an elegant seasonal display while offering a modern alternative to a traditional green tree. The striking black finish makes it ideal for contemporary interiors, themed decorations or anyone looking for a standout centrepiece during the festive season. Made from 100% virgin PVC, the tree is designed for practical seasonal use and features fire retardant tips for added peace of mind when decorating indoors. The wrapped construction means the branches are attached directly to the tree, helping make assembly simpler and reducing the time needed to get everything in place. This design also helps keep the overall shape consistent once assembled, so you can focus on styling rather than complicated setup. A sturdy metal base is included to help support the tree securely, while the plastic stand protector is designed to help protect your floor during installation and display. The combination of strong support and straightforward assembly makes this artificial tree a useful choice for busy households, retail spaces or larger rooms where a tall festive focal point is needed. As an artificial tree, it can be reused year after year, making it a practical addition to your Christmas decorations. The classic pine tip profile gives a familiar evergreen style even with its black finish, helping you create a festive look that feels both traditional in shape and modern in appearance. Whether placed in a living room, hallway or display area, this 12ft tree offers height, presence and convenience in one easy-to-use design. The generous 12ft size makes it suitable for rooms with higher ceilings and areas where you want a more dramatic seasonal impact. Its tall profile creates an eye-catching backdrop for lights, baubles and garlands, while the simple construction supports faster seasonal setup. With its combination of classic shaping, fire retardant tips and a secure metal base, this Artificial Alaskan Pine tree offers a dependable way to build an impressive Christmas display without using a real tree. Ideal for customers seeking an artificial Christmas tree with a distinctive look, this black Alaskan Pine design balances style and practicality. The fire retardant PVC tips, wrapped branch construction and included stand accessories all contribute to an easier decorating experience. If you want a reusable festive centrepiece with strong visual impact and familiar pine styling, this 12ft artificial tree is designed to deliver exactly that.

## Features
- Artificial Christmas tree in rich green with plenty of volume
- Realistic appearance thanks to detailed injection moulded needles
- Quick assembly and disassembly in the plug-in system
- Stable, foldable tree stand made of powder-coated steel with floor-friendly plastic feet
- Particularly low-maintenance

## Information
The artificial Christmas tree Prancer by tectake is the perfect choice to immerse your home in a cosy, festive atmosphere. The trees rich green and lifelike injection-moulded needles give it a realistic appearance that rivals a real fir tree. The accurately crafted branches offer ample space for all your favourite decorations, from classic baubles to sparkling lights. Thanks to the robust stand made of powder-coated steel, the artificial Christmas tree offers absolute stability even with fully laden branches. The plastic feet on the stand prevent scratches on delicate floors and ensure stability on any surface. Particularly practical: The plug-in mechanism allows for effortless assembly of the Christmas tree with just a few simple steps, without the need for additional tools. Afterwards, you can bend and shape the branches as you wish, and add your best decorations. You don't have to worry about falling needles or watering, as the artificial Christmas tree always remains in splendid form. Made from particularly durable and high-quality materials, this eye-catcher lasts for many years. It is therefore the ideal choice for all those who do not want the hassle of a real tree. After the holidays, the artificial tree can be easily dismantled into its individual parts and stored compactly. This way, it takes up little space and waits to shine in full glory again next year. With the artificial Christmas tree Prancer by tectake, you bring the magic of Christmas into your home!

## Features
- Snow covered green tips give a classic winter look indoors
- Hinged branches help make assembly quicker and easier
- PVC tips offer a practical decorative finish for reuse
- Metal stand helps support stability during seasonal display
- Suitable for homes, shops and other indoor festive spaces
- Fire-retardant construction is suitable for indoor seasonal displays.
- Hinged branches help make setup quicker and takedown simpler when the festive season is over.
- Includes a sturdy metal stand to help keep the artificial Christmas tree stable during display.
- Snow-covered green tips create a traditional winter appearance with added festive detail.
- Reusable design folds away neatly after use, making off-season storage more convenient.

## Information
Create a festive indoor display with the B&Q 8ft Californian Pine artificial Christmas tree, designed to bring a classic seasonal look to homes, shops, malls and other indoor settings. The tree combines a bushy profile with snow covered green tips, giving the appearance of a winter-inspired decorative centrepiece that suits traditional Christmas decorating schemes. Its hinged branch construction is intended to make assembly straightforward, while also helping when the tree is taken down and stored after use. A sturdy metal base is supplied to help keep the tree standing securely and provide added stability during display. Made with PVC tips and a metal frame and stand, this reusable tree offers a practical option for creating an inviting festive atmosphere year after year. It can be used for Christmas decorating as well as other seasonal or celebratory displays where an indoor decorative tree is needed. The design is suitable for indoor use and provides a simple way to build a welcoming focal point without requiring complicated setup. For households or commercial spaces looking for a dependable decorative tree, this Californian Pine model offers a balance of convenience, structure and seasonal appeal. The included stand with screws helps complete the setup, supporting the tree once assembled so it can be positioned ready for ornaments and lights if desired. Whether placed in a living room, reception area or retail environment, it offers a versatile festive feature that can be reused across multiple seasons.

## Features
- Authentic noble fir shape with snow tipped finish
- Mixed five-claw PE and PVC tips for natural look
- Heavy duty steel stand prevents tipping
- Three section plug-in design no tools needed
- Perfect centrepiece for living room or office

## Information
The noble fir christmas tree stands apart from traditional designs, with each branch tip delicately frosted with a snowy finish, creating a winter snow effect that feels elegant and frosty. The premium material blend combines pe tips for lifelike texture with pvc tips for added volume, achieving the perfect balance between realism and affordability. Built to last, the steel trunk and wide base ensure your tree stays firmly in place, while durable materials resist fading and deformation so your winter wonderland looks stunning year after year. Setup is quick and storage is easy, the three-section plug-in design lets you go from box to beautifully decorated in minutes. Perfect for living rooms, dining areas, hallways and larger indoor spaces, this snowy christmas tree brings a charming winter atmosphere to your home year after year.

## Features
- 25 layers
- 4213 branch tips
- Made of PE & PVC
- Indoor use only
- Easy assembly (instructions provided)
- 1 year warranty
- Metal stand included

## Information
The Basildon 9ft Artificial Christmas Tree by The Christmas Centre is a stunning centrepiece that will enhance your home over the holiday season. This artificial Xmas tree has a timeless elegance and goes well with any interior décor thanks to its full and rich look. The branches on this Xmas tree, which is a blend of PE and PVC, look genuine and are reminiscent of real trees. The thoughtful positioning of each tip results in realistic-looking foliage, and the symmetrical shape of the tree adds to its overall style. The Basildon tree's branches flow elegantly and provide you with lots of space to display your favourite ornaments. Easy to assemble, the remarkable solidity offered by the metal stand will ensure that your tree remains upright throughout Christmas. When the festivities are done, the tree can be disassembled and stored away in its box until next year. products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Beautiful warm white glow
- Brown bark effect & flocked finish
- 5m power cable for easy display
- Stand & ground stakes included
- Snow flocked for a magical, wintry finish

## Information
Add a winter forest feel to your home this Christmas with our light up snowy twig tree. Beautifully illuminated by warm white LEDs to create a warm, welcoming feature. The twig tree comes in a choice of sizes and is suitable for indoor and outdoor display. To capture the colour and texture of a real tree, we've wrapped the tree in brown tape. The tape has a bark effect finish for a beautiful, natural look. Plus, it's waterproof to prevent it peeling in the rain. For an enchanting winter-weathered look, we've designed the tree with bare branches and a snow flocked finish. And for full effect, weve also added a light dusting of snow to the trunk and base. The twig tree includes a screw-on base and a set of ground pegs to secure it to your lawn. For a lifelike finish, weve also designed the base with bumps to resemble the roots of a real birch tree.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Available in sizes 2ft, 3ft, 4ft, 6ft and 7ft
- Indoor use only
- Colour-changing fibre optics
- Includes a star topper with LEDs
- Sparkle baubles provided
- 1.8m black cable
- PLEASE NOTE - THIS TREE DOES NOT COME WITH A REMOTE CONTROL
- Timer included: 8hrs on/16hrs off

## Information
The images on show are of our actual tree. Even with meticulous wrapping, each tree needs to be assembled correctly to get the desired look. First, assemble the tree foundation and then (if needed) install the lower section. Extend the branches of the upper portion down until you discover the electrical connection point. After the connection is completed, make sure the upper and lower electrical connections are in place before putting the top section of the tree into the lower pole (because 2ft, 3ft, and 4ft trees are all one-piece, this step is not required). Fold the first layer of branches just above horizontal form, working your way up from the base of the tree; this should give the branches a narrow \"V\" shape. Once you reach the top layer of your tree, repeat these steps for the remaining tiers. Before you plug in your tree, attach any ornaments or other decorations it may have! If gaps are evident from different angles, raising the back branches relative to the front branches may help. This fills in the \"visual gaps\" without sacrificing the appearance of layers. Work your way down the tree, starting at the top, to disassemble it. Available here as a 2ft (60cm) tree.

## Information
Create a warm and elegant festive atmosphere with the Globrite 4ft 72 LED Birch Tree. Featuring a stylish silver birch design with glowing warm white twig lights, this pre-lit Christmas tree is ideal for adding decorative lighting to your home during the festive season. Designed with flexible bendable branches, the tree can easily be shaped to suit your space and styled with lightweight hanging decorations for a personalised display. Its slim profile makes it perfect for hallways, living rooms, bedrooms and compact spaces where a traditional Christmas tree may not fit comfortably. Suitable for indoor and sheltered outdoor use, this illuminated birch tree also includes outdoor pegs to help secure it in place on patios or garden displays. The pre-installed LEDs save time during setup while creating a cosy and welcoming glow instantly. Perfect for Christmas décor, parties and year-round ambient styling, this decorative twig tree combines practicality with timeless seasonal charm. Additional size variations are also available for larger spaces and statement displays.

## Features

## Information
Add a winter forest feel to your home this Christmas with our light up snowy twig tree. Beautifully illuminated by warm white LEDs to create a warm, welcoming feature. The twig tree comes in a choice of sizes and is suitable for indoor and outdoor display. To capture the colour and texture of a real tree, we've wrapped the tree in brown tape. The tape has a bark effect finish for a beautiful, natural look. Plus, it's waterproof to prevent it peeling in the rain. For an enchanting winter-weathered look, we've designed the tree with bare branches and a snow flocked finish. And for full effect, weve also added a light dusting of snow to the trunk and base. The twig tree includes a screw-on base and a set of ground pegs to secure it to your lawn. For a lifelike finish, weve also designed the base with bumps to resemble the roots of a real birch tree.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Available in sizes 2ft, 3ft, 4ft, 6ft and 7ft
- Indoor use only
- Colour-changing fibre optics
- Includes a star topper with LEDs
- Sparkle baubles provided
- 1.8m black cable
- PLEASE NOTE - THIS TREE DOES NOT COME WITH A REMOTE CONTROL
- Timer included: 8hrs on/16hrs off

## Information
The images on show are of our real trees. Even with meticulous wrapping, each tree needs to be assembled correctly to get the desired look. First, assemble the tree foundation and then (if needed) install the lower section. Extend the branches of the upper portion down until you discover the electrical connection point. After the connection is completed, make sure the upper and lower electrical connections are in place before putting the top section of the tree into the lower pole (because 2ft, 3ft, and 4ft trees are all one-piece, this step is not required). Fold the first layer of branches just above horizontal form, working your way up from the base of the tree; this should give the branches a narrow \"V\" shape. Once you reach the top layer of your tree, repeat these steps for the remaining tiers. Before you plug in your tree, attach any ornaments or other decorations it may have! If gaps are evident from different angles, raising the back branches relative to the front branches may help. This fills in the \"visual gaps\" without sacrificing the appearance of layers. Work your way down the tree, starting at the top, to disassemble it. Available here as a 3ft (90cm) tree.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Beautiful warm white glow
- Brown bark effect & flocked finish
- 5m power cable for easy display
- Stand & ground stakes included
- Snow flocked for a magical, wintry finish
- Brown bark effect  flocked finish
- Stand  ground stakes included

## Information
Add a winter forest feel to your home this Christmas with our light up snowy twig tree. Beautifully illuminated by warm white LEDs to create a warm, welcoming feature. The twig tree comes in a choice of sizes and is suitable for indoor and outdoor display. To capture the colour and texture of a real tree, we've wrapped the tree in brown tape. The tape has a bark effect finish for a beautiful, natural look. Plus, it's waterproof to prevent it peeling in the rain. For an enchanting winter-weathered look, we've designed the tree with bare branches and a snow flocked finish. And for full effect, weve also added a light dusting of snow to the trunk and base. The twig tree includes a screw-on base and a set of ground pegs to secure it to your lawn. For a lifelike finish, weve also designed the base with bumps to resemble the roots of a real birch tree.

## Features
- Pre-lit white LEDs create an eye-catching festive
- Pre-lit white LEDs create an eye-catching festive
- PVC construction gives a lightweight feel indoors
- Strong metal stand helps support stable display use
- Easy to fold down store and reuse each Christmas
- Eight light modes let you customise the festive lighting to suit your preferred atmosphere.
- Wrapped construction gives the tree a fuller, more natural-looking appearance.
- Mains-powered cool white LED lights include a 2 m cable for convenient indoor placement.
- The included strong metal stand provides stable support for indoor display.
- Fire-retardant construction is suitable for indoor seasonal use.

## Information
Bring a modern festive look to your home with this 5ft pre-lit black Alaskan pine Christmas tree. The bold black finish gives a contemporary twist to classic seasonal decorating, while the built-in white LED lights help create an eye-catching display with less effort at setup time. Designed for indoor use, this artificial tree offers a practical option for creating a seasonal centrepiece in living rooms, hallways, dining areas or other display spaces where a compact yet stylish tree is needed. Made from PVC, the tree has a lightweight feel that makes it easier to handle when setting up, decorating and storing away after the season. The material also supports a natural-looking pine style that works well with traditional baubles, garlands and other festive decorations. A strong metal stand is included to help support stable placement once assembled, giving you a reliable base for your Christmas display. This tree is designed for straightforward seasonal use, with easy assembly that helps reduce the time spent preparing your room for Christmas. Once the festivities are over, it can be folded down and stored ready for reuse in future years, making it a practical choice for repeated seasonal decorating. Its reusable construction offers convenience for households looking for an artificial tree that can be brought out year after year without needing replacement each season. The 5ft height makes it suitable for rooms where space is limited but you still want a noticeable festive feature. It provides enough presence for creating a cheerful indoor display without overwhelming smaller spaces. The black colourway gives flexibility if you prefer a more modern theme, or if you want to pair the tree with metallic, white or colourful decorations for contrast. As a decorative artificial Christmas tree, this model combines style and convenience in one simple design. The pre-lit format removes the need to add separate lighting strands before decorating, helping you get started more quickly. Whether used as a main family tree or as an additional seasonal feature in another room, it delivers an attractive festive focal point that can be enjoyed throughout the Christmas period. The Alaskan pine style gives the tree a familiar seasonal appearance while the PVC construction keeps it practical for home use. Its sturdy stand and easy assembly make it suitable for customers who want an artificial tree that is simple to position and manage each year. For anyone seeking a compact pre-lit Christmas tree with a contemporary black finish and built-in white lighting, this 5ft option offers an appealing blend of convenience and visual impact.

Whether placed in a living room, hallway or dining area, this 4ft pre-lit Christmas tree offers a ready-made festive display with minimal effort. Its blend of green foliage effect, changing lights and stable metal stand makes it a practical seasonal decoration for homes looking for an attractive and reusable Christmas centrepiece.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Available in sizes 2ft, 3ft, 4ft, 6ft and 7ft
- Indoor use only
- Colour-changing fibre optics
- Includes a star topper with LEDs
- Sparkle baubles provided
- 1.8m black cable
- PLEASE NOTE - THIS TREE DOES NOT COME WITH A REMOTE CONTROL
- Timer included: 8hrs on/16hrs off

## Information
The images on show are of our real trees. Even with meticulous wrapping, each tree needs to be assembled correctly to get the desired look. First, assemble the tree foundation and then (if needed) install the lower section. Extend the branches of the upper portion down until you discover the electrical connection point. After the connection is completed, make sure the upper and lower electrical connections are in place before putting the top section of the tree into the lower pole (because 2ft, 3ft, and 4ft trees are all one-piece, this step is not required). Fold the first layer of branches just above horizontal form, working your way up from the base of the tree; this should give the branches a narrow \"V\" shape. Once you reach the top layer of your tree, repeat these steps for the remaining tiers. Before you plug in your tree, attach any ornaments or other decorations it may have! If gaps are evident from different angles, raising the back branches relative to the front branches may help. This fills in the \"visual gaps\" without sacrificing the appearance of layers. Work your way down the tree, starting at the top, to disassemble it. Available here as a 4ft (120cm) tree.

## Information
Bring a warm festive feel to your home with this 3ft prelit Christmas tree, designed for indoor seasonal decorating. The tree features a firework style branch shape that gives it a full decorative look, while the PVC material helps create a classic needle effect. Its compact size makes it suitable for smaller rooms, hallways, porches or anywhere you want an easy Christmas display without taking up too much floor space. This prelit design saves time during setup and helps you create an attractive focal point with less effort than decorating a tree from scratch. The structured branch style is ideal for adding baubles, ribbons and other decorations to suit your chosen theme. Whether you are styling a cosy corner at home, adding seasonal detail to an office reception area or creating a simple festive feature in a shop display, this tree offers a practical and versatile option. Made with PVC, the tree is intended for repeated seasonal use when cared for appropriately and stored carefully between celebrations. The compact 3ft format is especially useful where space is limited, making it easier to add festive atmosphere without needing a larger tree. Its prelit format also supports quick decorating, helping you get ready for Christmas with less fuss. For best results, place the tree on a stable surface and follow any assembly or care guidance supplied with the product. Keep away from heat sources and always use electrical items in line with the manufacturer’s instructions. This tree is suitable for indoor decorative use only and can be combined with your own lights, ornaments and finishing touches if desired. A straightforward choice for customers looking for a small prelit Christmas tree with a decorative branch style and a traditional festive appearance.
Bring a touch of holiday spirit with this pre-lit Flowers Fibre Optic LED Pre-Lit tree, perfect for creating a warm and festive atmosphere in your home.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Hinged sections help make assembly quicker at Christmas
- Mixed PE, PET and PVC tips create natural-looking depth
- Snow-dusted finish adds a classic winter festive touch
- 140 warm white LEDs provide an inviting ready-lit glow
- Metal stand included for stable support throughout use
- Fire-retardant artificial Christmas tree designed for festive indoor display.
- Mains-powered warm white LED lighting includes a 2m cable for convenient connection.
- Hinged branches help simplify setup, making the tree quicker and easier to assemble for the Christmas season.
- The included metal stand helps keep the artificial Christmas tree securely positioned during seasonal display.
- Warm white LEDs offer 8 lighting modes, including waves, sequential, chasing or flash, slow fade, twinkle or flash, steady on and combination.

## Information
Create a cosy festive focal point in your home with this 4ft pre-lit artificial Christmas tree, designed to offer a full and elegant seasonal display year after year. The green Lapland Fir style combines mixed PE, PET and PVC foliage to help create a natural-looking finish with varied tip shapes and a rich, layered appearance. A white snow-dusted effect adds extra winter charm, making it a stylish choice for living rooms, hallways, offices or smaller spaces where you want a classic Christmas look without the need for a larger tree. This tree is hinged for easier assembly, helping make seasonal set-up quicker and more straightforward. products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Available in sizes 2ft, 3ft, 4ft, 6ft and 7ft
- Indoor use only
- Colour-changing fibre optics
- Includes a star topper with LEDs
- Sparkle baubles provided
- 1.8m black cable
- PLEASE NOTE - THIS TREE DOES NOT COME WITH A REMOTE CONTROL
- Timer included: 8hrs on/16hrs off

## Information
The images on show are of our real trees. Even with meticulous wrapping, each tree needs to be assembled correctly to get the desired look. First, assemble the tree foundation and then (if needed) install the lower section. Extend the branches of the upper portion down until you discover the electrical connection point. After the connection is completed, make sure the upper and lower electrical connections are in place before putting the top section of the tree into the lower pole (because 2ft, 3ft, and 4ft trees are all one-piece, this step is not required). Fold the first layer of branches just above horizontal form, working your way up from the base of the tree; this should give the branches a narrow \"V\" shape. Once you reach the top layer of your tree, repeat these steps for the remaining tiers. Before you plug in your tree, attach any ornaments or other decorations it may have! If gaps are evident from different angles, raising the back branches relative to the front branches may help. This fills in the \"visual gaps\" without sacrificing the appearance of layers. Work your way down the tree, starting at the top, to disassemble it. Available here as a 5ft (150cm) tree.

## Features
- Quick and easy to assembly
- Energy efficient LEDs which last up to 50,000hrs
- Hinged Construction
- Made of high quality PE, PET and PVC mixed leaf
- Compact 4ft size makes this pre-lit Christmas tree well suited to smaller rooms, corners and hallways where floor space is limited but you still want a festive centrepiece with plenty of seasonal impact.
- Built-in warm white lights help create an inviting Christmas glow without the need to add separate string lights first, saving time during setup and making decorating feel quicker and more straightforward.
- PVC branch construction gives the tree a classic artificial finish that can be used again each year, offering a practical alternative to choosing and disposing of a fresh cut tree after the season ends.
- Traditional green colour works well with many decorating styles, so you can keep the look simple or personalise it with baubles, ribbons and other ornaments to suit your own home décor.
- Suitable for indoor festive display in living rooms, dining spaces or reception areas, this pre-lit tree offers an easy way to add Christmas atmosphere while keeping installation neat and manageable.

## Information
Bring a cheerful festive look to your home with this 4ft pastel stars and baubles fibre optic Christmas tree. Designed as an artificial indoor decoration, it offers a simple way to add seasonal light and colour without the need for real needles or regular watering. The green finish gives the tree a traditional base, while the pastel decorative styling creates a softer, modern Christmas display that suits a variety of room settings. This pre-lit tree features automatically changing light colours to create an eye-catching illuminated effect throughout the season. The flashing or off mode provides straightforward control, so you can switch between active lighting and a simpler display when preferred. With a metal stand included, the tree is designed for stable placement in the home, helping it sit securely during use. Made from PVC and metal, this artificial Christmas tree is intended for repeated seasonal use and can be brought out year after year. Its easy installation and dismantling make it practical for busy households that want a festive centrepiece without complicated setup. The compact 4ft size is suitable for smaller rooms, corners, halls or spaces where a full-sized tree would feel too large, while still giving you plenty of seasonal presence. Because it is an artificial design, this tree can be safely used in homes with children and pets when positioned appropriately and used as intended. It is a convenient choice for anyone wanting a decorative Christmas feature that combines lights, structure and festive styling in one piece. The pastel star and bauble look adds charm, while the fibre optic effect helps create a bright seasonal atmosphere. Whether placed in a living room, hallway or dining area, this 4ft pre-lit Christmas tree offers a ready-made festive display with minimal effort. Its blend of green foliage effect, changing lights and stable metal stand makes it a practical seasonal decoration for homes looking for an attractive and reusable Christmas centrepiece.
Bring a touch of holiday spirit with this pre-lit Pastel Stars and Baubles Fibre Optic tree, perfect for creating a warm and festive atmosphere in your home.
