products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Available in sizes 2ft, 3ft, 4ft, 6ft and 7ft
- Indoor use only
- Colour-changing fibre optics
- Includes a star topper with LEDs
- Sparkle baubles provided
- 1.8m black cable
- PLEASE NOTE - THIS TREE DOES NOT COME WITH A REMOTE CONTROL
- Timer included: 8hrs on/16hrs off

## Information
The images on show are of our real trees. Even with meticulous wrapping, each tree needs to be assembled correctly to get the desired look. First, assemble the tree foundation and then (if needed) install the lower section. Extend the branches of the upper portion down until you discover the electrical connection point. After the connection is completed, make sure the upper and lower electrical connections are in place before putting the top section of the tree into the lower pole (because 2ft, 3ft, and 4ft trees are all one-piece, this step is not required). Fold the first layer of branches just above horizontal form, working your way up from the base of the tree; this should give the branches a narrow \"V\" shape. Once you reach the top layer of your tree, repeat these steps for the remaining tiers. Before you plug in your tree, attach any ornaments or other decorations it may have! If gaps are evident from different angles, raising the back branches relative to the front branches may help. This fills in the \"visual gaps\" without sacrificing the appearance of layers. Work your way down the tree, starting at the top, to disassemble it. Available here as a 6ft (180cm) tree.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Warm white LEDs create an inviting festive glow
- PVC branches give a practical green tree finish
- Hinged design helps make assembly more straightforward
- Flat base provides steady support once assembled
- Compact 4ft size suits smaller indoor spaces
- 170 built-in warm white LEDs provide an inviting festive glow without separate light strings.
- Mains-powered lighting with a UK plug-in system for convenient operation.
- Hinged branch construction helps simplify setup and shaping before decorating.
- Sturdy metal stand provides dependable support for this 4ft artificial Christmas tree.
- Fire-retardant design for added reassurance during indoor seasonal use.

## Information
Bring a classic festive feel to your home with this 4ft Pre-lit Green Helsinki Christmas Tree. Designed for seasonal decoration, it features a traditional green finish and built-in warm white LED lights to create a welcoming glow without the need for separate light strings. The tree is made from PVC for a practical artificial finish that can be reused year after year, making it a convenient choice for Christmas decorating indoors. This tree is supplied in a compact 4ft size, making it suitable for smaller rooms, hallways, offices or as an additional decorative feature alongside larger displays. Its modern twig-inspired look offers a decorative alternative to more traditional full-branch styles while still providing an attractive festive presence. The flat base helps the tree stand securely once assembled, giving you a stable centerpiece for your seasonal setup. Assembly is required, and the hinged construction is designed to make the process more straightforward. Once in place, the built-in LED lighting can be powered simply by plugging in the transformer, helping you enjoy quick festive illumination with less effort. The long-life energy saving LEDs are described as lasting up to 50,000 hours, offering added convenience for repeated seasonal use. This artificial Christmas tree is intended for indoor decoration and can help transform living spaces into a cheerful winter display. It is suitable for customers looking for a pre-lit option with a natural-looking green finish, practical assembly features and reliable support from the included stand. As with all indoor electrical decorations, the transformer should remain plugged indoors at all times during use. With its combination of pre-lit convenience, PVC construction and compact height, this Helsinki tree offers an easy way to create a festive focal point. It suits homes that need an attractive Christmas tree without the upkeep of real foliage, while still delivering a warm seasonal atmosphere through its integrated lighting and simple design.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Available in sizes 2ft, 3ft, 4ft, 6ft and 7ft
- Indoor use only
- Colour-changing fibre optics
- Includes a star topper with LEDs
- Sparkle baubles provided
- 1.8m black cable
- PLEASE NOTE - THIS TREE DOES NOT COME WITH A REMOTE CONTROL
- Timer included: 8hrs on/16hrs off

## Information
The images on show are of our real trees. Even with meticulous wrapping, each tree needs to be assembled correctly to get the desired look. First, assemble the tree foundation and then (if needed) install the lower section. Extend the branches of the upper portion down until you discover the electrical connection point. After the connection is completed, make sure the upper and lower electrical connections are in place before putting the top section of the tree into the lower pole (because 2ft, 3ft, and 4ft trees are all one-piece, this step is not required). Fold the first layer of branches just above horizontal form, working your way up from the base of the tree; this should give the branches a narrow \"V\" shape. Once you reach the top layer of your tree, repeat these steps for the remaining tiers. Before you plug in your tree, attach any ornaments or other decorations it may have! If gaps are evident from different angles, raising the back branches relative to the front branches may help. This fills in the \"visual gaps\" without sacrificing the appearance of layers. Work your way down the tree, starting at the top, to disassemble it. Available here as a 7ft (210cm) tree.

The tree features 9 modes via the included remote: steady, fading, and flashing effects in warm white, multicolour, or both combined — plus an alternating mode. How are the lights powered? The tree itself is mains-powered — simply plug in to enjoy. The remote control runs on a button cell battery (not included). Is it suitable for outdoor use? Designed for indoor use. For best results and safety, display in a dry, sheltered location. Safety Information For indoor use only. Do not use if damaged or wet. Unplug by grasping the plug, not the cord. Keep cords, batteries, and small parts away from children and pets — the remote's button cell battery (not included) can cause serious harm if swallowed.

## Features
- Fibre Optic Christmas Tree
- Star Topper
- 8 Changing Light Modes
- 5ft tall artificial Christmas tree with a snow white finish that creates a bold winter feature in the home or workplace
- Mixed PE and PVC tips are designed to give a fuller appearance with layered texture and a more natural-looking shape
- white LED bulbs so the tree is ready to decorate straight away
- Hinged branches help support quicker assembly by allowing the sections to open into place more easily during setup
- Supplied with a metal stand to help keep the tree upright once positioned

## Information
Create a festive focal point in your home with this 3ft multicolour fibre optic Christmas tree. Designed for straightforward installation and dismantling, it offers an easy way to enjoy seasonal lighting without the need for separate string lights. The artificial PVC construction is made for repeated use across future Christmases, giving you a decorative tree that can be brought out year after year. With 90 tips and 95 LEDs, it delivers a bright illuminated look in a compact size that works well in smaller rooms, on tabletops or in feature corners. Eight different light modes allow you to vary the effect to suit the mood of the room, from a softer glow to a more animated display. The green-tipped finish helps maintain a traditional Christmas tree appearance while still offering the convenience of built-in fibre optic lighting. Suitable for homes where safety and practicality matter, it provides an attractive decorative option for households with children and pets when placed appropriately indoors. The supplied stand and adapter make setup more convenient, helping you get your festive display ready with less effort. Its width of approximately 45cm means it can fit neatly into compact spaces without overwhelming the room, while still offering enough presence to stand out as part of your seasonal décor. Whether you are refreshing your own decorations or looking for a simple centrepiece for a small space, this artificial tree combines classic styling with modern lighting effects for an easy seasonal update.
Bring a touch of holiday spirit with this pre-lit Multicolour Modes Fibre Optic LED Pre-Lit tree, perfect for creating a warm and festive atmosphere in your home.

## Information
Our Aurora Winter Glow Christmas tree brings a magical, snow-kissed look to any living room, grand hallway or shop display. Delicately flocked in soft white for a frosted, just-fallen-snow finish, it's pre-lit with vibrant multi-colour and warm white LEDs offering 16 lighting functions - including twinkle effects and quick colour-flip transitions - making it a stunning centrepiece for the whole festive season. What's included 1 x pre-lit flocked Christmas tree 1 x Stand 1 x Remote control Dimensions 6ft: approx. 180cm height, approx. 105cm at base, 1234 branch tips 7.5ft: approx. 228cm height, approx. 125cm at base, 1870 branch tips Good to know Sent by courier with free standard UK delivery Covered by a 1-year manufacturer warranty FAQs What sizes are available? This tree is available in two heights - 6ft and 7.5ft - so you can choose the best size for your space. Does it need assembly? Minimal assembly required. Simply unfold the branches and attach the tree to its stand. The sections connect via built-in power sockets, so lights link up automatically as you build the tree. A few bolts are hand-tightened during setup, no power tools required. Can I change the lighting effects? Yes, the tree features 16 modes via the included remote, covering steady, slow-fade, and twinkle effects in warm white, multicolour, and pastel, plus quick and slow colour-flip transitions and a demo mode that cycles through them all. How are the lights powered? The tree itself is mains-powered, simply plug in to enjoy. The remote control runs on a button cell battery (not included). Is it suitable for outdoor use? Designed for indoor use. For best results and safety, display in a dry, sheltered location. How is it delivered? Sent by courier with free standard UK delivery. Safety Information For indoor use only. Do not use if damaged or wet. Unplug by grasping the plug, not the cord. Keep cords, batteries, and small parts away from children and pets. The remote's button cell battery (not included) can cause serious internal injury if swallowed, sometimes within hours. If a battery is swallowed or you suspect ingestion, seek immediate medical attention. Ensure the battery compartment is securely closed at all times.

The balanced proportions and full branches make it simple to style with ornaments, ribbons or other decorations if desired, while the built-in lights provide a ready-made base for your festive theme. ## Information
Our Richmond Fir is a traditional Christmas tree for any living room, grand hallway or shop display. The tree features a 3 part system offering much easier assembly, simply connect the base to the three pieces, unfold the branches, reposition and plug it in. Key features 9 lighting modes with remote control — warm white, multicolour, or combined effects in steady, fade, flash, and alternating patterns Dual-colour LED lights, pre-lit with no extra wiring needed to connect sections Full, lifelike hinged branches for quick assembly and a traditional Christmas look Sturdy stand for lasting, stable everyday use What's included 1 x pre-lit Richmond Fir Christmas tree 1 x Stand 1 x Storage Bag 1 x Remote control Dimensions 6ft: approx. 180cm height, approx. 100cm at base, 798 branch tips 7ft: approx. 210cm height, approx. 125cm at base, 1,098 branch tips Good to know Sent by courier with free standard UK delivery Covered by a 1-year manufacturer warranty FAQs Does it need assembly? Simple assembly required — the tree sections connect together (with built-in power sockets linking the lights automatically) and attach to the stand with 3 hand-tightened bolts, no power tools needed. Once assembled, gently spread out the branches and tips to shape your tree. What lighting modes does it have? The tree features 9 modes via the included remote: steady, fading, and flashing effects in warm white, multicolour, or both combined — plus an alternating mode. How are the lights powered? The tree itself is mains-powered — simply plug in to enjoy. The remote control runs on a button cell battery (not included). Is it suitable for outdoor use? Designed for indoor use. For best results and safety, display in a dry, sheltered location. Safety Information For indoor use only. Do not use if damaged or wet. Unplug by grasping the plug, not the cord. Keep cords, batteries, and small parts away from children and pets — the remote's button cell battery (not included) can cause serious harm if swallowed.

## Information
Our Aurora Winter Glow Christmas tree brings a magical, snow-kissed look to any living room, grand hallway or shop display. Delicately flocked in soft white for a frosted, just-fallen-snow finish, it's pre-lit with vibrant multi-colour and warm white LEDs offering 16 lighting functions - including twinkle effects and quick colour-flip transitions - making it a stunning centrepiece for the whole festive season. What's included 1 x pre-lit flocked Christmas tree 1 x Stand 1 x Remote control Dimensions 6ft: approx. 180cm height, approx. 105cm at base, 1234 branch tips 7.5ft: approx. 228cm height, approx. 125cm at base, 1870 branch tips Good to know Sent by courier with free standard UK delivery Covered by a 1-year manufacturer warranty FAQs What sizes are available? This tree is available in two heights - 6ft and 7.5ft - so you can choose the best size for your space. Does it need assembly? Minimal assembly required. Simply unfold the branches and attach the tree to its stand. The sections connect via built-in power sockets, so lights link up automatically as you build the tree. A few bolts are hand-tightened during setup, no power tools required. Can I change the lighting effects? Yes, the tree features 16 modes via the included remote, covering steady, slow-fade, and twinkle effects in warm white, multicolour, and pastel, plus quick and slow colour-flip transitions and a demo mode that cycles through them all. How are the lights powered? The tree itself is mains-powered, simply plug in to enjoy. The remote control runs on a button cell battery (not included). Is it suitable for outdoor use? Designed for indoor use. For best results and safety, display in a dry, sheltered location. How is it delivered? Sent by courier with free standard UK delivery. Safety Information For indoor use only. Do not use if damaged or wet. Unplug by grasping the plug, not the cord. Keep cords, batteries, and small parts away from children and pets. The remote's button cell battery (not included) can cause serious internal injury if swallowed, sometimes within hours. If a battery is swallowed or you suspect ingestion, seek immediate medical attention. Ensure the battery compartment is securely closed at all times.

## Features
- Pre-strung with warm white LEDs  no tangled wires or hassle, just beautiful festive light ready to shine.
- 8 lighting modes from steady to twinkling
- Mixed PE PVC and pine tips for natural look
- Red berries and pinecones pre-attached
- Sturdy metal stand for stable support
- Segmented pole for quick assembly
- Nearly 800 branch tips for full look

## Information
Transform your home into a winter wonderland with this spectacular pre-lit mixed tip christmas tree. Standing at an impressive height with nine layers and over one thousand branch tips, this grand tree delivers unparalleled fullness and presence, perfect for high ceilings, open-plan living spaces, or entrance halls. Crafted with a premium blend of 152 realistic pe tips, 810 lush pvc tips, and 93 pine needle tips, this tree looks stunning from every angle. Pre-strung with 380 warm white leds, it offers brilliant coverage without the need for separate lights, and the eight lighting modes – from a calm steady glow to twinkling and dynamic chasing effects – let you create the perfect atmosphere for every occasion. Adorned with red berries and pinecones, this tree arrives beautifully decorated and ready to impress. The heavy-duty steel pole and iron stand ensure rock-solid stability, while the segmented pole design allows for effortless section-by-section assembly. The low-voltage mains adapter guarantees safe operation, making this tree a magnificent and practical choice for families.

- Pre-lit Artificial Christmas Tree

## Information
Bring a classic festive centrepiece into your home with this 10ft green Alaskan Pine pre-lit artificial Christmas tree. Designed for larger spaces, it offers a full seasonal look with a natural appearance and plenty of room for hanging ornaments and decorations. The wrapped construction helps create a traditional tree profile, while the PVC material is made to be durable, fireproof and easy to store after the season has passed. With a green finish and metal stand included, it is a practical choice for creating an instant Christmas display in living rooms, hallways or open-plan areas where height makes an impact. This artificial tree includes 420 multicolour LEDs to add colour and atmosphere without the need for separate fairy lights. There are eight lighting modes available, allowing you to choose from waves, sequential, slogs, chasing/flash, slow fade, twinkle/flash, steady on and combination effects. Whether you want a calm glow or a more lively display, the light settings make it easy to suit different moods across the festive period. The tree’s 1800 tips help create a fuller look once the branches are arranged after installation, giving you space to personalise the finished shape with baubles, ribbons and other decorations. Made from PVC and metal, this pre-lit Christmas tree combines decorative appeal with everyday practicality. The materials are selected to support compression resistance as well as long-lasting seasonal use, while the artificial design helps reduce the effort involved in setting up festive decor each year. It is supplied as one piece for straightforward decorating once assembled and positioned in place. For best results, take time to spread out the branches after installation so the tree achieves its fullest appearance. This 10ft tree is suited to customers looking for a substantial Christmas feature that brings brightness, height and traditional greenery into larger home spaces. The design focuses on convenience as well as visual impact. With built-in lighting already fitted to the branches, there is less preparation needed compared with decorating a plain artificial tree from scratch. The multicolor LED effect adds variety across the season, while the classic pine style keeps the overall look familiar and timeless. Ideal for creating a festive focal point in bigger rooms, this green artificial Christmas tree offers a balanced mix of size, light and decorative flexibility for seasonal decorating.

## Features
- Slim design fits tight corners and hallways
- Mixed PE and PVC tips for natural fullness
- Fade-resistant materials keep rich green colour
- Heavy duty steel stand for stable support
- Three section plug-in design no tools needed

## Information
This slim christmas tree offers all the festive presence without taking over your living space. With a narrow silhouette and shorter branches, it's designed specifically for smaller rooms, tight corners, and homes where floor space is at a premium. Crafted with pe tips for realistic outer texture and pvc tips for fluffy fullness, it delivers a natural, dense look from every angle. The steel trunk and metal base keep it rock-steady, while the three-section design makes assembly a breeze. Fade-resistant materials ensure it stays vibrant year after year. This tree brings the magic of christmas without the clutter.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Wrapped branches make assembly quicker and easier
- 3134 tips help create a fuller festive appearance
- Sturdy metal stand supports the tree once built
- Plastic stand covers help protect your flooring
- Fire-retardant PVC tips offer added peace of mind
- Warm white LED lights create a soft, festive glow without requiring separate tree lighting.
- Attached branches are fixed directly to the tree, supporting quicker setup and a neat wrapped construction.
- Fire-retardant tips provide an added safety feature for indoor Christmas displays.
- The sturdy metal stand includes plastic covers to help protect your floor during display.
- Reusable artificial design makes the tree suitable for festive decorating year after year.

## Information
Bring classic festive style into your home with this 12ft green artificial Alaskan pine Christmas tree. Designed for a tall, elegant display, it features classic pine tips for a refined seasonal look that works well with lights, baubles and other decorations. The tree is made from PVC, with fire-retardant tips made from 100% virgin PVC, offering a practical option for indoor Christmas decorating. Its wrapped construction means the branches are attached directly to the tree, helping to make assembly simpler and quicker when setting up for the season. A sturdy metal base provides reliable support once assembled, while plastic stand covers help protect the floor underneath. With 3134 tips included, this artificial tree is designed to create a full decorative appearance that suits larger rooms, halls or open-plan living spaces. The green finish offers a traditional Christmas look that can be reused year after year as part of your seasonal décor. For households looking for an impressive centrepiece without the upkeep of a real tree, this artificial Alaskan pine combines familiar styling with straightforward assembly and stable support. Its generous height makes it ideal for creating a standout festive focal point in homes where space allows for a taller display. Whether decorated simply or dressed more fully, the tree provides a versatile base for your Christmas styling while keeping setup practical and manageable.

Bring plenty of magic into your home this festive season with the Basildon 6ft Artificial Pre-Lit Christmas Tree. Designed to mimic the natural full-bodied silhouette of a real evergreen, this Xmas tree combines realistic PE tips with durable PVC inner foliage for a lush, realistic look without the mess of falling needles. Pre-strung with warm white LED lights and 8 functions including static, setting up your festive centrepiece has never been easier. Say goodbye to tangled string lights and hello to an instant cosy glow! Easy to assemble, the remarkable solidity offered by the metal stand will ensure that your tree remains upright throughout Christmas. When the festivities are done, the tree can be disassembled and stored away in its box until next year. ## Information
Bring the magic of fireworks to your garden at the touch of a button. Create a spectacular display in your garden with the Firework Tree, a stunning outdoor light feature inspired by the beauty of exploding fireworks. Its unique branching design is covered with bright, colourful LED lights that burst outwards to create a magical firework effect. Using the easy-to-use smartphone app, you can control the display, change colours, adjust brightness and select different lighting effects to suit any occasion. The Firework Tree creates dynamic displays of all colours including blue, pink, purple and green light that look spectacular after dark. products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Built-in warm white LEDs save time at setup
- Eight light modes let you vary the festive mood
- Hinged branches make assembly quicker and easier
- PVC foliage gives a classic green pine appearance
- Metal stand helps support the tree once assembled
- Choose from 9 light modes, including waves, sequential, slo-glo, chasing or flash, slow fade, twinkle or flash, steady on and combination.
- Warm white LED lights create a traditional festive glow for indoor Christmas decorating.
- Hinged branches make assembly quicker and easier, helping the tree take shape with minimal setup.
- Mains-powered design with a 2m cable for convenient connection to a household socket.
- Fire retardant construction supports safer seasonal use.

## Information
Create a warm festive setting with this 12ft pre-lit green Alaskan pine artificial Christmas tree. Designed for homes that want a fuller seasonal centerpiece, it offers a natural look with plenty of space for ornaments and decorations. The PVC construction helps give the tree its classic artificial pine finish, while the hinged design supports straightforward assembly and shaping once the sections are in place. Built-in warm white LEDs are fitted to save time and reduce the need for separate light strings. The lighting includes multiple modes, giving you flexibility to adjust the display to suit your room and festive mood. Options include waves, sequential, slogs, chasing/flash, slow fade, twinkle/flash, steady on and combination, so you can vary the atmosphere through the season. The tree is supplied with a metal stand to help support it once assembled. As with many artificial trees of this type, arranging the branches after installation will help achieve the best appearance and create a fuller look. The green finish provides a traditional Christmas style that works well as a centerpiece in medium to larger rooms where height makes an impact. This artificial Christmas tree is intended for repeated seasonal use and offers a practical alternative to a real tree when you want decorative impact without ongoing needle drop or watering. Its pre-lit format is useful for busy households looking to simplify setup while still enjoying an attractive festive display. The combination of built-in lighting, hinged construction and included stand makes it a functional choice for creating a classic Christmas scene indoors. With its tall profile and traditional green styling, this 12ft tree gives you room to personalize your decorations while keeping a polished seasonal look. Whether styled simply or filled with ornaments, it offers a versatile base for creating an impressive festive feature year after year.

Bring the magic of fireworks to your garden at the touch of a button. Create a stunning light display in your garden with this App-Controlled Firework Tree. products.sourceDescription:
## Features
- 804 RGB micro LEDs across 18 cascading strands create a bright, full cone-tree display with vivid colour-changing effects that stand out in gardens, entrances and larger festive spaces.
- Personalise the display from your phone using the Super Pix app, with control over colours, brightness, preset scenes, timers and schedules for a more flexible Christmas lighting setup.
- Music sync adds an interactive effect by allowing the lights to respond to the rhythm of music, making the tree especially suitable for parties, events and entertaining over the festive season.
- Designed for flexible indoor and outdoor placement, with a 5-metre lead cable for easier positioning and reliable mains power for continuous seasonal illumination.

## Information
Create a striking centrepiece for your Christmas display with the Pegdev 2.4m RGB LED Cone Tree Light. Standing at an impressive 2.4 metres tall, the cone-shaped design combines 18 cascading light strands with 804 colour-changing micro LEDs to produce a bright, full and eye-catching festive display. Use the Super Pix smartphone app to personalise the lighting to suit your Christmas theme, with control over colours, brightness, animations and lighting effects directly from your phone. The illuminated star topper provides a traditional festive finishing touch while the RGB lighting gives the display a more modern, customisable look. Ideal for gardens, patios, entrances and larger indoor spaces, the tall cone design delivers the appearance of an illuminated Christmas tree without the need for branches, decorations or extensive dressing. It also works well as a focal point for parties, seasonal events and commercial Christmas displays. A sturdy metal base helps support the structure throughout the festive season, while the supplied mains power setup provides reliable illumination. Whether used on its own or alongside other Christmas decorations, this illuminated cone tree is designed to create a colourful display that stands out after dark. This version gives the customer a clearer reason to choose it: 804 LEDs, 2.4m height, 18 cascading strands and app-controlled RGB effects all contribute to a much more substantial and customisable display than many simpler pre-lit Christmas trees. B&Q listings also commonly use this kind of visual, benefit-first language when selling larger illuminated Christmas decorations.

## Information
Create a festive centrepiece with this 8ft pre-lit Californian pine artificial Christmas tree, designed to bring a snowy winter look to your home or seasonal display. The snow-covered tips give the tree a frosted finish, while the warm white LEDs add a welcoming glow without the need for separate string lights. With 1382 tips, it provides a full and decorative shape that looks attractive whether styled with ornaments or left simple and illuminated on its own. The hinged branch design helps make assembly quicker and less demanding, so you can spend less time setting up and more time enjoying the finished display. Once the season is over, the same hinged construction also makes disassembly and storage more straightforward. A metal stand is included to help support the tree during use, and the PVC tips are made for repeated seasonal decorating year after year. At approximately 100cm at the widest point, this tree offers a substantial profile suited to living rooms, hallways, reception spaces or retail displays where a strong festive feature is needed. The integrated warm white LEDs are energy saving and have a long life of up to 50,000 hours, helping provide reliable seasonal lighting across many Christmases. Whether you prefer a traditional decorated tree or a snowy illuminated look, this artificial Californian pine offers a practical and eye-catching option for Christmas decorating. The combination of snow-covered leaves, realistic styling and integrated lighting creates an inviting festive atmosphere that works well in both home and shop settings. Use it as a ready-lit base for baubles, ribbons and garlands, or enjoy its wintry appearance as it comes. Built with convenience in mind, it brings together easy setup, durable materials and decorative impact in one seasonal tree. This artificial Christmas tree is intended for indoor festive use as part of your seasonal décor. Its full shape, snowy finish and pre-lit design make it easy to create an impressive display without buying additional lights separately. For customers looking for a classic green Christmas tree with a frosted effect and integrated illumination, this option delivers a balanced mix of style, practicality and repeated-use value.

## Features
- Firework-inspired design with illuminated branching arms
- App controlled for easy operation from your smartphone

- 4600 LED lights in total

## Information
Bring the magic of fireworks to your garden at the touch of a button. Create a stunning light display in your garden with this App-Controlled Firework Tree. Designed with multiple illuminated branches, it produces a vibrant firework-style effect that adds colour and atmosphere to any outdoor space. Control the lights directly from your smartphone to customise the display to suit your mood, occasion or event. Choose from different colours, lighting effects and brightness levels for a display that's easy to personalise. The Firework Tree creates dynamic displays of all colours including blue, pink, purple and green light that look spectacular after dark. With over 20 different functions all controlled by the AI PIXEL app. This tree measures 9ft or 270cm high and has 5 layers of branches and the firework at the top. Each individual firework has 20 stems with 7 LED's in each so a total of 140 LED's on each firework!

## Features
- Ethereal snowy spindle tree design
- Authentic wood log base for stability
- Pairs well with silver stag ornaments
- Available in multiple impressive sizes

## Information
Winter enchantment comes alive with this magnificent snowy spindle tree, rooted in an authentic wood log base. The delicate branches, dusted with pristine artificial snow, create an ethereal display that captures the magic of a frost-kissed forest. This centerpiece pairs beautifully with our collection of silver standing stag ornaments, which add a mystical woodland element when arranged alongside. For a cohesive holiday display, incorporate our natural nutcracker decorations and wicker bell ornaments to achieve a harmonious blend of rustic and whimsical elements. The tree's thoughtful design allows it to serve as both a standalone statement and part of a larger seasonal arrangement. Available in multiple sizes within the collection, this large variant offers impressive presence while maintaining the artistry of its smaller counterparts. The careful attention to detail in the snow application and natural wood base makes each piece appear uniquely organic. When merchandised with our coordinating holiday accessories, particularly the silver stag collection and traditional nutcrackers, it presents an irresistible display that prompts multiple item purchases. The addition of the Noel Collection wicker bells creates layers of texture that appeal to discerning customers seeking a curated holiday aesthetic.

products.sourceDescription:
## Features


## Information
Bring the magic of a winter woodland into your home with the Christow Nordmann Fir Artificial Christmas Tree. Layered, uneven branches, tapered with gaps between them, capture the sparse, natural look of a real winter woodland fir. Lifelike PE and classic PVC tips add depth, fullness, and natural charm. The tree comes in three sections with hinged branches, twist-and-lock poles, and a sturdy metal stand for easy setup and styling. Instructions are included to guide you every step of the way. Start by securing the base section into the stand and pulling down the branches. Then repeat with the middle and top, locking each section into place and shaping the branches as you go. Crafted with a blend of moulded PE and traditional PVC tips, the tree has a natural woodland look with lifelike texture and detail. While the PE tips add depth and definition, the PVC tips help fill out the branches to replicate a real fir tree.

## Features
- Magical winter centrepiece
- Luxury snow flocked tips
- Hinged branch construction
- Green metal stand included
- Easy to assemble

## Information
Bring the magic of a winter woodland into your home with the Christow Nordmann Fir Artificial Christmas Tree. Layered, uneven branches, tapered with gaps between them, capture the sparse, natural look of a real winter woodland fir. Lifelike PE and classic PVC tips add depth, fullness, and natural charm. The tree comes in three sections with hinged branches, twist-and-lock poles, and a sturdy metal stand for easy setup and styling. Instructions are included to guide you every step of the way. Start by securing the base section into the stand and pulling down the branches. Then repeat with the middle and top, locking each section into place and shaping the branches as you go. Crafted with a blend of moulded PE and traditional PVC tips, the tree has a natural woodland look with lifelike texture and detail. While the PE tips add depth and definition, the PVC tips help fill out the branches to replicate a real fir tree.
